Hourly rainfall totals from Australian weather stations for precipitation monitoring and short term forecasting.
Hourly PM2.5 concentration and related air quality variables in Beijing for air pollution analysis.
Hourly ambient benzene concentration from monitoring stations for air quality assessment.
Electroencephalography recordings during motor imagery tasks sampled every 0.001 second to study task related brain activity.  ￼
Slow cortical potential electroencephalography recorded during self regulation sessions sampled every 0.004 second.  ￼
Follow up slow cortical potential electroencephalography from a similar self regulation experiment sampled every 0.004 second.  ￼
Electrocardiography recordings for atrial fibrillation detection sampled every 0.008 second.  ￼
Invasive arterial blood pressure signals from pigs for cardiovascular physiology research.
Central venous pressure signals from pigs for cardiovascular function analysis.
Photoplethysmography signals of blood volume pulse sampled every 0.008 second, including motion conditions for robust pulse analysis.  ￼
Continuous physiological waveforms including heart rate and respiration recorded over extended hours for monitoring and modeling in clinical settings.
Clinical and cognitive electroencephalography sampled every 0.002 second for studies of neural activity and biomarkers.  ￼
Multivariate IoT sensor logs from real machines sampled every 0.02 second capturing operational variables for condition monitoring.
Audio time series of spoken phonemes for speech pattern analysis and recognition.  ￼
Worm locomotion time series represented as eigenworm posture components for behavior and genetics studies.  ￼

Pressure level atmospheric variables such as geopotential and temperature from ERA5 reanalysis sampled every 3 hours in this collection.  ￼
Daily temperature and rainfall series for weather modeling and baseline forecasting.
Stellar brightness time series for variable star analysis and classification.
Daily river flow at Walkerton Ontario in cubic meters per second for hydrological modeling.  ￼
Hourly multivariate time series of air quality temperature and related weather variables for Chinese cities from the KDD Cup 2018 task.  ￼
Daily counts of births in the United States for demographic pattern analysis.  ￼
Daily sunspot counts as a proxy for solar activity for long term solar cycle study.  ￼
Worm motion sensor signals sampled every 0.033 second capturing movement patterns for organism behavior analysis.  ￼
Hourly counts of pedestrians from city sensors for urban activity and mobility analysis.  ￼
Daily page view counts for Wikipedia articles for web traffic modeling and forecasting.  ￼
